category: a variant of a click-intensive MMO game that permits automated play
attribute: it would permit bots, and confine that permission to designated servers or to designated restricted account types, so bot play is not allowed on the ordinary world
attribute_note: "they just allow bots"; "they can be certain servers or certain account types, like ironman"

category: a general-purpose Linux distribution with staged background updates
attribute: updates would stage safely and invisibly in the background and be adopted by booting into the new version at the next reboot, and the distribution would keep broad package support while doing so
attribute_note: "updates safely staged in the background invisibily"; "Next time I reboot my computer, I boot into that new version"; "I wish there was like a Debian but atomic that has broad support"

attribute: transcoding would be fast enough to be usable at run time, where a take of multiple seconds for large images is not usable
attribute_note: "fast on-the-fly WebP encoding"; "it was unusably slow multiple seconds for large images"

category: memory or context storage for an assistant agent
attribute: it would load the memory accumulated by an existing agent instance so the user does not have to begin again from nothing
attribute_note: "load my current agents memory because I don t want to start over fresh"

category: an application instrumentation and observability layer
attribute: a codebase would be annotated once and the decision of whether an event surfaces as a metric, a log, or a trace would be made dynamically at run time, including by a single click taken in a monitoring dashboard
attribute_note: "annotate my code base once, and let the ultimate decision to expose something as a metric / log / trace be dynamic at runtime"; "I d like to say The next time something like this occurs again, please save me a trace"; "just do that with a single mouse click"

attribute: the cards would be generated from the material just studied rather than typed by the user
attribute_note: "a way to have Gemini make a bunch of cards for use with spaced repetition software"

category: tagging and categorising items inside a news reader
attribute: a reader would let the user file items of a particular kind into their own tags, the tagging being something the reader does rather than something the site offers
attribute_note: "I wish there was a way to tag this type of the posts, but at least my HN client allows to tag the authors"

attribute: when a server's published address is dead, the new canonical address would be found from activity the user already holds, identified by the same signing key, so an up-to-date view is possible with no address in hand
attribute_note: "is there a way to find the new canonical PDS"; "index every log from everywhere and just look for new entries signed by the same key"; "There would be no way to know if you have the latest posts without the PDS address"

attribute: the game would let a stuck player admit defeat and act on it: back up and retry in a different guess order, take a hint, and give up and be shown the solution
attribute_note: "Is there an Undo feature so I can back up and try a different order of guesses"; "Can I get a hint"; "Is there a way to give up and see the solution order of word guesses"

category: bot and scraper traffic filtering at a reverse proxy
attribute: filtering would be added to an existing reverse proxy the user already runs, as an add-on, and would decide per request by the requesting client's user agent string whether to block or to proxy
attribute_note: "a tool to actually send traffic to a tool like this"; "a Traefik plugin that can block or proxy requests based on useragent"

category: seeding a library of already-downloaded items
attribute: the seeding would be bulk: many already-downloaded items would be fed to other holders of the same collection at once, rather than one at a time
attribute_note: "a way to bulk seed the books we DO have downloaded"

category: a personal collection and recommendation tool for source repositories
attribute: the input to the tool would be the list of things the user had starred, standing in for bookmarks the user had once lost, and the output would be suggestions drawn from that list
attribute_note: "I had lost my bookmarks once and I lost a lot of github projects so I decided to use stars as my bookmarks"; "I have got around 1800k projects starred"

category: a static checker for source code
attribute: it would constrain the language to a declared subset, mechanically refusing constructs the user considers outdated and pushing toward one or a few ways of doing a thing, and would be applied continuously like a linter
attribute_note: "something like a linter to force you to stay within some subset of c++"; "hard to avoid language constructs that are outdated or enforce a single or a few ways of doing things. A c++ subset could be nice."

attribute: its storage layer would be easy to extend with custom backends, so that storage classes beyond the default tiers can be added, and the base store would remain open source and self-hostable
attribute_note: "a good open source S3 alternarive that s easily extendable with custom storage backends"; "AWS offers IA and Glacier in addition to the defaults"

category: a hosted uptime and network monitoring service
attribute: a hosted service would cost on the order of 25 cents per monitor per month, which would put individual non-critical monitors within reach of one person rather than only within enterprise purchasing
attribute_note: "I wish there was an uptime robot for like 25 cents a monitor a month"; "things like uptime robot are enterprise geared and too expensive for me"

category: blog and social media post metadata
attribute: a post would carry an optional field in which its author names their own overlapping interests, so that other people can find and follow that author by interest
attribute_note: "I wish there was an optional field people could add so others with overlapping interests could follow a blog / socialmedia / etc."

category: a version control client operation for selecting hunks of a change
attribute: splitting a change into selected parts would be done through the exact same interface used for staging selected parts, so one interface covers both selections
attribute_note: "any tool that allows you to selectively stage can use the exact same interface to selectively split"

category: a reference resource tracking machine-learning model releases
attribute: the resource would be easy to keep current and would compare models on specific fields: latest version, best use case, speed measured against a stated baseline, and the hardware needed to run each one
attribute_note: "some easy resource to keep up with the latest models"; "latest versions, best use case, performance in terms of speed relative to some baseline, and hardware requirements to run it"

attribute: it would report which items and folders consume a user's storage inside an account held with a hosted drive provider, reading that provider's account rather than the local filesystem
attribute_note: "anything close to WinDirStat for google drive"; "I really need something like this."
